- This is a classic lump_sum (lender disbursal) pattern

input.rationale: Loan disbursal payment from Vidya Finserv covering four students. The payment amount (₹2,97,500) equals the exact sum of invoices for Dev Joshi (INV-00010: ₹75,000), Kabir Bose (INV-00011: ₹120,000), Kiara Agarwal (INV-00012: ₹90,000), and Navya Agarwal (INV-00013: ₹12,500). The four students listed in the payment notes match exactly with these four invoices, confirming this is a lender lump sum disbursal paying multiple student invoices in one transaction.
